manifest_role: Content-bound enumeration of every canon subject pending baseline review, with the disposition and written reasoning of one accountable reviewer. Presenting this manifest to --accept advances the baseline. It closes no work item, certifies no stage, and changes no status.
instructions: Fill reviewer_ref, and per subject a disposition (unaffected | successor_required | blocked) and a review_note that argues it from what actually changed.

`unaffected` must be ARGUED. Say why this subject's change does not reach the stages, modules, and work items named in review_required below. An unargued `unaffected` is a mechanical accept with extra steps.
Never rewrite a verified closure to absorb a semantic change: disposition it `successor_required` and open a successor record that states what must now be proven.
Do not edit the ids or digests. They bind this manifest to one exact revision, and --accept refuses if they drift.

subjects.review_note: Owner-ratified truth-status correction records the implemented owner-boundary repair while retaining row-complete final-invoker, denial, concurrency, crash, and release proof as open M3 successor work; it does not alter category, topology, GoalRun placement, or v1/v2 contracts.

Owner-ratified implementation matrix correction distinguishes implemented affected-boundary migration from the still-open retained route-complete evidence; the m3 authority census and generic consumption successors remain the proof owners.

Owner-ratified wallet API status correction reflects independent resolution and deterministic atomic consumption on affected boundaries without claiming row-complete release qualification; v1/v2 bytes and semantics remain preserved.

Owner-ratified wallet doctrine status correction reflects the implemented source-neutral admission boundary while leaving retained final-invoker, concurrency, crash, and route-complete proof open under the M3 successors.
